content:
I believe most of you have some idea about the IELTS. It is the International English Language Testing System. It provides countries with English as their first languages as a way to test the proficiency of people. It is usually tested for those aspirants who wish to study, work or immigrate in an English speaking country. It is important when the foreign countries are considered as language is the first barrier that non-natives to their countries have to face upon arrival. Casper Academy of Excellence is the best IELTS training institute in Ernakulam to give best classes.

As the requirements of band scores will differ with different countries and institutions, you need to know about the IELTS band score requirements. Here we can see the IELTS requirements as per your needs and the country you wish to go for your studies or work.

Why we Need a Good Preparation for IELTS?

People who are familiar with formats of other such proficiency tests will definitely say that, IELTS is tougher. IELTS is complicated because it heavily relies on the instincts of the test taker. Tests other than IELTS like PTE, TOEFL, CELPIP, Duolingo, TOEIC, etc. are more technical which makes them to be more predictable and easy to approach for non-native speakers. In case of IELTS, it is non-predictable and not much approachable which makes it complicated. Casper Academy of Excellence is the best for IELTS coaching in Kochi with expert trainers and well prepared modules.

IELTS Band Score Requirements for Students

The below listed are the major destinations for foreign nationals all across the globe for education. This is due to their diverse culture, impeccable quality, competitive pay and the lucrative prospects for skilled people. The minimum band score required are as follows:

  • Australia – for Bachelor’s 6.0 and for Master’s 6.5
  • New Zealand – for Bachelor’s 6.0 to 6.5 and for master’s 6.0 to 6.5
  • Canada – for Bachelor’s 5.5 to 6.0 and for Master’s 6.0 to 6.5
  • USA – for Bachelor’s 6.0 and for Master’s 7.0
  • UK – for Bachelor’s 6.5 and for Master’s 7.0 to 7.5

IELTS Band Score Requirement for Immigration or Permanent Residency (PR)

In case of students, IELTS band score cut-off is set by the respective universities. Similarly, in case of immigration cut-off is set by the respective government bodies that are responsible for the same. These scores are further signified by the points that they give based on the band scores. In case of Australia, we must get at least 7 band score and below 7 will result in 0 points. In case of New Zealand, it is 6.5 and minimum 5 for dependent visa. Casper Academy is the best IELTS coaching centre in Cochin to help you get your desired band score.
